title: Your sister is crying on the phone
scenario: While you are abroad, a call from an unknown number sounds like your sister. She says her phone was stolen, she is in trouble, and she needs you to transfer money to a friend immediately before her battery dies.

answers.A: End the call and contact your sister through a known number, another family member, or a pre-agreed family verification question.
answers.B: Keep the caller talking while you message another family member from a second device to verify the story.
answers.C: Send a small amount first; if she confirms receipt, send the rest.

explanation: Voice cloning and spoofed context can make emotional emergencies feel authentic. Independent family verification breaks the pressure loop.
proTip: In a family emergency, verify the person—not the emotion.
